summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Sandili’s path to heaven through devoted, disciplined wifely conduct and introduces a tale on the power of conciliation over force.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the celestial realm, the radiant Sandili sits on a shining chariot in white garments as Sumana gazes at her in wonder.
A devoted wife rises at dawn in a clean household, reverently offering a seat and service to her husband returning home.
A calm Brahmana stands unafraid in a dark forest before a looming Rakshasa who has seized him as prey.
